settingsPage.subtitle: Manage server configuration and feature flags.

general.title: General
general.smallModelHint: Controls which model receives lightweight/free requests when routing.
general.apiKeysHint: One key per line (or comma-separated). Leave empty to disable request authentication.
general.legacyAuthNote: Legacy fallback remains enabled for env {{env}} or config.apiKey when auth.apiKeys is empty.
general.anthropicApiKeyHint: Optional. Used for exact Claude /v1/messages/count_tokens calls; without it, the server falls back to local token estimation.
general.anthropicApiKeyEnvNote: Runtime fallback remains available through env {{env}}. Leaving this field empty does not override a server-side environment variable.

accountAffinity.title: Account Affinity
accountAffinity.label: Enable account affinity
accountAffinity.hint: Routes requests to the account that last successfully handled the same session. Applies to both free and premium models.

reasoning.title: Reasoning efforts
reasoning.emptyState: No reasoning overrides. Add a model below.
reasoning.itemHint: Overrides reasoning effort for this model.

prompts.title: Extra prompts
prompts.description: Inject extra system prompts per model.
prompts.hint: Add or edit prompt snippets injected for specific models.
prompts.itemHint: Adds prompt content before model execution.

aliases.title: Model aliases
aliases.description: Map friendly alias names to upstream model IDs.
aliases.defaultBehaviorHint: Default behavior: {{behavior}} original model IDs. Each alias can override this setting.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.modelRefreshIntervalHint: Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.
advanced.allowOriginalModelNamesHint: Default behavior when aliases do not override original model IDs.
advanced.useFunctionApplyPatchHint: Include the apply_patch function tool when forwarding requests through the Responses API.
advanced.forceAgentHint: Affects Copilot Premium request consumption counting: when off, every agent conversation request counts as 1 (same as the VS Code extension); when on, multiple requests in the same session count only once per model.
advanced.compactUseSmallModelLabel: Route compact requests to small model
advanced.compactUseSmallModelHint: When enabled, compact requests use the configured smallModel; otherwise they use the requested model.
advanced.messageStartInputTokensFallbackHint: When enabled, estimates message_start input tokens when upstream usage is unavailable.
advanced.useMessagesApiHint: When enabled, Claude-family models may use Copilot's native /v1/messages endpoint.
advanced.useResponsesApiWebSearchHint: When enabled, /v1/responses keeps web_search tools and forwards them upstream.
advanced.responsesApiContextManagementModelsHint: List of model IDs that should receive Responses API context_management compaction instructions.
advanced.providersDescription: Configure upstream providers (currently anthropic only). Each provider key becomes a route prefix (/:provider/v1/messages).
